hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *js/sandbox/car/js/*.js) idx="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/js/sandbox/car/index.html"; cur=$(grep -oE '\?v=[0-9]+' "$idx" | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | sort -n | tail -1); next=$((cur+1)); sed -i -E "s/\?v=[0-9]+/?v=$next/g" "$idx";; esac 2>/dev/null || true
